description: Read one function call in full by its id from functions_list_calls: cause, request (method, path, headers, body; sensitive headers hidden), response (status, body), event payload, the error with its stack trace, the call's console output and timings. To run it again after a fix, use functions_replay_call.

maxBodyChars.description: Cut each body at this many characters; default 16384

name: functions_get_call
